_comment: Copy to data/config.json, which git ignores. Every key but school is optional.
_comment_school: A profile from schools/, e.g. georgetown_law. Empty: mail is refused unless you allow a sender by hand.
_comment_sources: Senders and mailing lists to read beyond what your school's profile knows. Add them with ./fff sources, or here.
_comment_page: Your own words at the top of the page. about names an HTML file; git ignores data/about.html.
_comment_artifact: Where the routine republishes the page, if you publish it as a Claude Artifact.
_comment_orgs: Org pages with schema.org event data, read on every refresh.
_comment_imap: Only if your school allows IMAP app passwords. No password goes in this file: store it in the macOS Keychain (see ingest/mail.py) and name the service here.
